reason: My architect already hands me renders and 3D models inside their fee, so I'd be paying twice for something I already get. Plans change constantly with my clients, and at $500 a round that adds up fast.
objection: What happens every time the client changes the plan? $500 a round on top of $1,500, when the architect's renders are already paid for and they revise them as part of the job.
would_change_my_mind: Unlimited or very cheap revisions through the design phase, and proof it saves me a change order or two on a real job, not just a nicer picture.
